title: Construct the shortest 36-step lift of the fixed PR5430 projection
body:
## Summary

Construct an attaining 36-call universal restored lift of Nicholas Stone's fixed PR5430 projection. The new word is `374717236747275473071030571727164702`; deleting its twelve coordinate-7 calls gives exactly `341236425430103051216402`.

```diff
- fixed PR5430 projected state set: minimum >= 36, attainment unclaimed
+ same projected state set: exact minimum = 36, explicit attaining word
```

Claim type: **finite construction certificate with a scoped optimality corollary using the cited PR5430 lower bound**. The predecessor theorem is a dependency, not an audit deliverable. The new package directly checks this construction without importing or replaying any predecessor scientific verifier. No new kappa or selected-frontier change is claimed. Search stopped at the first verified word.

This contribution was produced by Nick Petalas. Credit Nicholas Stone / [PR5430](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5430) for the parent and matching obstruction; conorholds / PR3058, Ross Richardson / PR943, Douglas Colkitt / PR1185, Nick Petalas / PR5234 and their retained connector lineage. Independent human and formal proof-kernel review are unclaimed.

## Evidence

- **Before:** PR5430 proves a 36-call lower bound for the fixed projection and expressly leaves attainment unclaimed.
  **After:** the explicit word has 36 distinct prefix states, covers all 256 differences and attains that cited lower bound. Its coordinate counts are `(4,4,4,4,4,2,2,12)`.
- Two separate exact algorithms enumerate prefix-pair differences and direct interval parities. Both cover all 256 masks.
- Literal execution checks every one of 512 assignments to eight sources and the dirty accumulator, with 256 recoveries per assignment: **131,072 checked recoveries**. Eleven rejection controls pass in normal and optimized execution.
- Both registered commands pass locally on CPython 3.12.15 in 0.0903 and 0.0871 seconds. These are replay-budget checks, not performance claims.
- Registered package replay, source pins, six-file committed-byte/mode/source-history checks, official export/integrity checks, syntax and function-size inspection pass. A read-only Git-free export with empty PATH passes optimized direct replay with identical stdout and all seven export files unchanged.

From the repository root, reproduce with the exact local interpreter path:

```sh
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/fixed-projection-shortest-lift
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -I -W error -B research/fixed-projection-shortest-lift/verify.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -I -O -W error -B research/fixed-projection-shortest-lift/verify.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/fixed-projection-shortest-lift --check-source-history --check-modes
```

Other machines may substitute their CPython 3.12 path. Only the standard library is required. Expected markers include `PASS_FIXED_PROJECTION_SHORTEST_LIFT length=36 differences=256 dirty_recoveries=131072 controls=11` and `PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE`. The generated stdout receipt binds package hashes and the independently constructed interval table; no receipt is handwritten or committed.

## Scope and limitations

The exact minimum is for closed singleton paths whose projected state set is the specific PR5430 set. The new word also attains the optimum in the narrower class of literal insertions into its parent. This does not improve the global eight-source bound or classify seven-source parents. The optimality corollary uses PR5430's cited lower bound; the fresh finite checks establish the construction.

The written dirty-payload invariant extends coordinatewise to arbitrary bit width. Obtaining, retaining and comparing the two observations still needs a physical consumer and complete pricing. No COPY/ERASE, native/frame/owner contract, target delivery, complete recursive invoice, precision/tape implementation, supplier/compiler admission or full multiplication theorem is supplied. The five selected framework assumptions remain. No predecessor scientific suite, selected cold replay, Lean or Docker build was run. No local verification obligation was deferred to CI.

Canonical main was refreshed before committing and remains `7c49fe32c55de02c2c873655c804b16e4c3fef0a`, priority revision 8, selected PR6030. The bit-new-register-model card is explicitly changed to this connector side result. [Advance CLAIM](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166#discussioncomment-19363537). Live claims/reservations, open/account PRs, merged searches and current-main exact-word/general-object searches were checked. Cached remote coverage includes 438 open PRs and 6,422 Discussion records; sparse local notes, arbitrary historical diffs and unpublished work remain limits.

## Open next questions

- Can a different seven-source optimal parent admit a universal restored lift shorter than 32 calls? Begin with a literal parent and insertion word, then certify all 256 differences. This fixed parent cannot provide that improvement.
- Can a physical consumer use the interval table with a favorable full observation and restoration bill? Specify retained observations, their lifetimes and complete COPY/ERASE and source tariffs first.

## Related open work

No open PR studying this fixed projected state set or its 36-call lift minimum was found in the refreshed live searches. Merged PR5430 is the direct predecessor; its lower bound is cited and not independently replayed here. No extra computations checked another contribution's numbers.

The completion refresh inspected all nine other open account PRs created since the advance CLAIM. None studies this fixed projected state set or computes a competing lift minimum. No numerical disagreement was identified, and no extra scientific computation checked another contribution.

- [PR6488](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/6488) classifies monotone seeds of an arithmetic projection recurrence. Its projection object and quantity differ from this connector prefix-state lift; no common numerical value is computed here.

## CI notes

The completed checks were read once with `gh pr checks`; run metadata confirms the matching head, completed status and successful conclusion. The registered replay certifies normal and optimized execution of the bounded construction checks. All local scientific, metadata, source-history and export checks listed above also passed. Hosted success does not establish independent human or formal proof-kernel acceptance of the cited lower bound, the written payload proof or a complete multiplication theorem. No failed or waived check remains.

## Merge Danger

**Door:** two-way.

**Blast Radius:** package.

Only six files under `research/fixed-projection-shortest-lift/` are added. Shared code, frozen predecessor packages, source archives and selected-frontier files are unchanged.
